style: adult animated drama illustration, cel-shaded characters with clean bold linework and realistic proportions, expressive faces and body language, detailed near-photoreal painted background, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16, no text, no watermark

characters.Miss Lee: Korean-American woman in her sixties, short silver hair, green cardigan, round glasses, warm smile
characters.Marcus (kid): nine-year-old Black boy, short twists, red hoodie, blue backpack
characters.Marcus (grown): Black man in his late twenties, short twists, red work jacket, gentle eyes

shots.prompt: Morning on a city block of row houses: Miss Lee holding a wooden garden gate open, three kids rushing through with backpacks, Marcus grinning up at her
Close two-shot: Miss Lee bending to fix Marcus's backpack strap at the gate, both laughing
Over Marcus's shoulder: Miss Lee waving goodbye from the gate as the kids run toward a school bus
Same block years later in autumn: Miss Lee, older, walking slowly with a cane, struggling with the heavy gate and grocery bag
Marcus jogging over, holding the gate open for her and taking her grocery bag, she looks up surprised and moved
Close-up: Miss Lee's hand squeezing Marcus's arm at the open gate, both smiling, golden light
